overview: Matched case-control study at the tertiary ED with incidence density sampling of four controls per case.
population: Adults meeting the frequent attender definition at the tertiary ED with an index date from March 2023 to December 2025.
exposure: Case management enrolment before the index date, read from the case management file; time since enrolment and contact count as secondary exposures.
procedures: Cases are identified from linked ED, hospital and death data. For each case, four controls are sampled from frequent attenders at risk on the case's event date, matched on age band, sex and calendar month. Research assistants read files with a written abstraction guide; 10 percent are read twice.

outcomes.name: Odds ratio for death or ICU admission with enrolment
outcomes.measure: Conditional odds ratio for enrolment before the index date, cases against matched controls
outcomes.why: The association the health authority needs.

outcomes.name: Time since enrolment
outcomes.measure: Odds ratios by time since enrolment category

outcomes.name: Abstractor agreement
outcomes.measure: Kappa for enrolment date on a 10 percent double-read sample

feasibility: About 945 files at the tertiary ED fit within the research assistants' time.
biasMitigation: Matching on age, sex and calendar month
Adjustment for prior visits and comorbidity

parsimony.simplestPath: One site, one exposure, one outcome definition.
